sentences.en: The police are hunting an escaped convict in this area.
sentences.zh: 警方正在此地区搜捕一名逃犯。

sentences.en: The police have started a nationwide hunt for the criminal.
sentences.zh: 警方已经在全国范围内展开追捕这名罪犯的行动。

sentences.en: It became popular among young people to wear hunting boots.
sentences.zh: 穿狩猎靴在年轻人中变得流行起来。
